blocks.x: Credentials users carry — portable, privacy-preserving verification for workforce and customers.

Identity verification is repeated everywhere and owned nowhere: employee onboarding repeats checks across systems, customers re-prove themselves to every subsidiary, supply-chain partners exchange documents by email. We implement decentralized identity with W3C Verifiable Credentials: issuers (HR, regulators, accredited bodies), wallets for holders, and verifiers checking cryptographic proofs — with selective disclosure so users prove 'over 18' or 'certified forklift operator' without exposing the whole document.

Institutional deployments need the trust layer: governance frameworks defining who may issue what, revocation infrastructure, biometric-binding where regulation requires it, and recovery paths for lost credentials. We deliver against eIDAS 2.0 / EUDI wallet expectations in the EU and comparable regimes elsewhere, integrating with existing IAM rather than replacing it — credentials augment your identity plane; they do not fork it.
